explication: TrafficMonitor is a Windows desktop network and system monitor. The main workflow is to collect network and system metrics, present them in a floating window or taskbar display, and optionally retain traffic history. Additional capabilities include adapter selection and network details, skins, hardware monitoring, and plugins. The graph combines README-documented product behavior with sampled source evidence; several feature implementations were not sampled, so those links are documented rather than inferred from imports.
